name: frontend-alb-5xx-errors
title: Frontend load balancer is repeatedly receiving HTTP 5xx responses
description: Frontend targets have returned more than one HTTP 5xx response during each of the last five minutes.
investigation_steps: Review the matching frontend logs to identify the failing requests.
Check the frontend ECS service, target group health and running tasks.
Check for recent deployments or infrastructure changes.

query: fields @timestamp, status, request_method, request_uri, upstream_status, upstream_response_time, aws_request_id, @message, @logStream
